name: FabriPlas Metal
old_description: Processing Time 8-10 weeks from order placement. Please read Shop policies before purchase.
about:
FabriPlas Metal operates from Bennet, Nebraska, as a handmade, made-to-order metalworking shop. The company crafts decorative metal panels, privacy screens, and architectural inserts entirely in-house, using metal sheets sourced from the United States.

The product line includes over 60 standard designs such as wildlife, nature, geometric, and coastal-themed panels, as well as room dividers, fence toppers, railing inserts, and pergola panels. Standard panels are cut from 14-gauge mild steel (0.0747 in) with pre-drilled mounting holes and included hardware. The shop also works in aluminum, stainless steel, copper, and brass, offering custom fabrication of bent flanges, tabs, hinges, and custom graphics. All design and production are done in-house by a skilled team; the company does not mass-produce.

FabriPlas Metal serves architectural firms, contractors, interior designers, landscapers, and residential customers across all 50 states. The company highlights collaboration with industry professionals on architectural and outdoor projects, both indoor and outdoor.

The business emphasizes 100% American-made materials and labor, handcrafted quality over mass production, and in-house design control. It positions its differentiators as domestic sourcing, custom capability, and a high level of skill and attention to detail.
